name: Malibu Village Mall
demographics: Malibu Village Mall attracts an affluent, upscale demographic reflective of Malibu's exclusive coastal community, with visitors typically in the 35-65 age range and household incomes well above $150,000 annually. The trade area serves both local Malibu residents and tourists seeking a premium shopping experience in a scenic beachside setting. Shoppers tend to prioritize quality over quantity, favoring boutique retailers, specialty stores, and upscale dining options that align with the area's sophisticated, health-conscious, and environmentally aware lifestyle.
description: Malibu Village Mall stands as a premier shopping destination in the heart of Malibu, California, offering visitors an intimate and upscale retail experience along the iconic Pacific Coast Highway. Located at 3836 Cross Creek Road, this open-air lifestyle center embodies the relaxed yet refined character of Malibu's coastal community. The center features a carefully curated mix of boutique retailers, specialty shops, and dining establishments that cater to both discerning local residents and visitors exploring the Malibu coastline. With its convenient location near world-famous beaches and the Santa Monica Mountains, Malibu Village Mall serves as a natural gathering place for the community. The center's design reflects Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle, with walkable pathways and an inviting atmosphere that encourages leisurely browsing and dining. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, the mall maintains a strong reputation with a 4.5-star rating from over 300 reviews, testament to its quality tenant mix and visitor experience. Whether you're a local resident running errands or a tourist seeking an authentic Malibu shopping experience, Malibu Village Mall offers a distinctive blend of convenience and coastal charm.
summary: Malibu Village Mall is an upscale open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of Malibu, featuring boutique retailers and dining options that reflect the area's sophisticated coastal lifestyle. With its prime location on Cross Creek Road and strong community reputation, the center serves as a premier shopping destination for both residents and visitors to this exclusive beachside community.
